# x402api Agent Wallet

> Open-source persistent local agent-wallet CLI and portable skill for exact x402 payments. Version 0.2.2 authorizes only sponsored Base USDC and sponsored Solana USDC/USDT payments.

The `x402api` CLI runs on the buyer or agent host and keeps encrypted private
keys there. It is not hosted by or running inside WarpMetal; WarpMetal is a
separate merchant and reference integration.

The funded token balance is the wallet's primary spend permission. The optional
`--maximum-payment-atomic` setting adds a per-payment ceiling; it is not a
daily, cumulative, or merchant-specific policy. For launch payments, x402api
supplies ETH or SOL and charges the merchant tenant's prepaid gas credit. The
buyer must never be asked to fund native gas or fall back to buyer-funded gas.

TRON wallet management and low-level conformance code are included, but TRON
payment authorization is not supported by the public payer. The refill client
contract is shipped; the hosted refill-notification service is a separate,
not-yet-complete platform rollout. Production mainnet support remains subject
to the gates in the security policy.

## Start here

- [Project README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/x402api-com/x402api-agent-wallet/main/README.md): Installation, release status, spend permissions, supported rails, and runtime boundaries.
- [CLI reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/x402api-com/x402api-agent-wallet/main/skills/x402api-pay/references/cli-reference.md): Commands, environment variables, results, and stable error routing.
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/x402api-com/x402api-agent-wallet/main/skills/x402api-pay/SKILL.md): Canonical operating workflow for skill-aware agents.

## Payment and security

- [Safety rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/x402api-com/x402api-agent-wallet/main/skills/x402api-pay/references/safety.md): Funding authority, local ceilings, secrets, hostile input, backup, and retirement.
- [Merchant integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/x402api-com/x402api-agent-wallet/main/skills/x402api-pay/references/merchant-integration.md): Exact request envelopes, artifact handoff, submission, and reconciliation.
- [Threat model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/x402api-com/x402api-agent-wallet/main/docs/threat-model.md): Trust boundaries, controls, residual risks, and non-goals.
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/x402api-com/x402api-agent-wallet/main/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting and supported-version status.
- [Source provenance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/x402api-com/x402api-agent-wallet/main/docs/source-provenance.md): Extracted protocol sources and post-extraction synchronization record.
